character: Grand Massif valley village at 720m. One of France's Plus Beaux Villages — medieval market town with large cobbled square, 12th-century church. Full year-round services. Gondola to Grand Massif (30 min). Lively Wednesday market.
activities_nearby: Grand Massif gondola (30 min). Medieval square and market (Wednesdays). Via ferrata (Grand Massif). Hiking. Paragliding. River swim in Giffre.
